# llms.txt — LLM-Readable Project Description

> This file provides context for Large Language Models working with this codebase.

## Project

The Pride of Tirumala (TPT) Apartment Expense Tracker — a Progressive Web App for managing apartment maintenance finances.

## Stack

- React 18 + Vite (frontend framework)
- Google Sheets API v4 (database — no backend server)
- Google Drive API v3 (file storage for receipts and backups)
- Google Identity Services (OAuth 2.0 authentication)
- jsPDF (client-side PDF report generation)
- vite-plugin-pwa (service worker for offline support)
- Vanilla CSS with custom properties (design system)
- Lucide React (icon library)
- React Router v6 with HashRouter (routing)

## Purpose

Track monthly maintenance collection (₹3,000/flat × 10 flats), log expenses with receipt uploads, generate monthly PDF reports, manage emergency contacts and recurring reminders. All data stored in a human-readable Google Sheet that serves as the single source of truth. The workbook starts with a Guide tab and a Sample Data tab. Setup can fill live tabs with sample rows for testing, or leave them empty for production. After testing, Settings can archive the sample file and create a fresh sheet.

## Access model (critical)

There is **one society workbook** named `TPT-MaintenanceTracker` and **one founding owner**.

- Founding owner email: `th***@gmail.com` (full value only in `src/config/accessPolicy.js`)
- Only that account may **create** or **archive-and-recreate** the society spreadsheet
- Other Google accounts must **never** be auto-promoted to Owner and must **never** create a second tracker
- The founding owner adds users in **Settings → Access Control**. Default role is **Reader**
- Readers are shared the existing sheet as Google Drive **Viewer** (`reader`). Owners (if granted) get **writer**
- The founding owner cannot be removed or demoted
- Max 20 users, max 2 Owners (founding + at most one additional, granted only by the founding owner)
- Members discover the sheet via Drive `sharedWithMe` (scope includes `drive.metadata.readonly`), not via files they privately own
- Optional published ID: `public/sheet-config.json` `{ "spreadsheetId": "..." }`
- App write APIs use `withWriteAuth` so Readers cannot mutate through the UI even if Drive still has leftover writer
- Private copies a non-founding user created in their own Drive are **ignored** (that was the bug that showed a personal Gmail as Owner of a private copy)

Policy helpers live in `src/config/accessPolicy.js` and must be reused rather than copying role checks.

## Key Files

- `src/config/accessPolicy.js` — Founding owner, default Reader, grant/create rules
- `src/config/constants.js` — All configurable values and OAuth scopes
- `src/services/googleAuth.js` — OAuth 2.0 authentication (re-consent when scopes bump)
- `src/services/googleSheets.js` — All CRUD operations (the "backend")
- `src/services/googleDrive.js` — File upload, sharing, society-sheet discovery
- `src/services/sheetSetup.js` — Create workbook (founding owner only); upgrades formulas / Pending Dues
- `src/services/sheetFormulas.js` — Layman-readable Sheets formulas (Still Due, surplus/deficit, pending lookup)
- `src/services/pdfExport.js` — Monthly report PDF (₹ glyph + masked emails/phones)
- `src/contexts/AuthContext.jsx` — Auth state; fail-closed Access Denied for non-members
- `src/contexts/AppContext.jsx` — Global app state, toast notifications
- `src/pages/Dashboard.jsx` — Main financial dashboard
- `src/pages/Settings.jsx` — Configuration, user management, backups
- `src/pages/Setup.jsx` — Founding-owner wizard only
- `vite.config.js` — Build config with PWA and chunk splitting

## Constraints

- Max 20 users, max 2 owners
- 10 flats: 101, 102, 201, 202, 301, 302, 401, 402, 501, 502
- No backend server — fully client-side static hosting. Drive file ACL is the real write barrier; app ACL is defense in depth
- Must be deployable to GitHub Pages and Azure Static Web Apps
- PWA installable on iOS, Android, and desktop
- Fiscal year: September to August
- Indian Rupee (₹) currency formatting in the app and in generated PDFs
- PDF reports mask emails and phone numbers
- Existing workbooks can be upgraded (Settings → Backups → Refresh sheet layout) so Monthly Summary and Pending Dues stay correct without the app
- UI must remain usable on mobile (hamburger + bottom nav, stacked cards, 44px tap targets)

## Deployment

- GitHub Pages: Push to main → auto-deployed via GitHub Actions
- Azure Static Web Apps: Connected to GitHub, auto-deploys
- Base path: `/AppartmentApp/` for GitHub Pages
- After creating the society sheet, optionally paste the ID into `public/sheet-config.json` so members can resolve it without relying only on Drive search
